doc.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009

title: Spending money; mother signs Ali into the Army
summary: Ali made no spending money; his mother signed him into the Army to get him off the street.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: How did you guys make spending money back in those days?
I didn’t make any. My mom gave it to me. I wasn’t making no spending money at all.

No. And you know my mom and dad was giving me money. Until I went into the service. I went into the service when I was — I had to put up my age to get into the service because I was getting a little rambunctious and mom wanted me off the street. So she took me to the Army and signed me in.
Yeah. She wanted to get me off the street.
Was that ’52 or something? © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
